Where was net immigration highest?

The rankings compare the total number of people moving in minus those moving out across 194 countries. They use one UN series for all countries. Figures through 2023 are estimates. The UN published its 2024 projection in July of that year. National statistical offices can publish different or revised balances. UN World Population Prospects 2024
